CLUSTER.INFO.summary: Returns this node's Raft role, term, leader, indexes and the range membership.
CLUSTER.INFO.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of members

CLUSTER.ADDLEARNER.summary: Adds a node as a non-voting learner (ADR-0006).

CLUSTER.PROMOTE.summary: Promotes a caught-up learner to voter.

CLUSTER.REMOVE.summary: Removes a voter or learner from the range.

CLUSTER.TRANSFER.summary: Hands leadership to a caught-up voter.
